findings.title: Analysis Period Rating Distribution
findings.claim: During the analysis period (2026-04-20 to 2026-04-27), the average rating across all review sources was 4.38 out of 5, based on 16 reviews.
coverage_notes: Reviews from 3 source(s): google, instagram, talabat
assumptions: All reviews in the artifact are valid and represent genuine customer feedback
No filtering applied for review quality or authenticity

findings.title: Language Distribution in Reviews
findings.claim: During the analysis period, 16 reviews were received across 2 language(s). en: 12 reviews, ar: 4 reviews.
coverage_notes: All 3 sources represented: google, instagram, talabat
assumptions: Language field accurately reflects the language of each review
Reviews are not translated; original language is preserved

findings.title: Rating Trend: Analysis vs Previous Period
findings.claim: Average rating in the analysis period (2026-04-20 to 2026-04-27) was 4.38 stars (16 reviews), compared to 4.61 stars (23 reviews) in the previous period (2026-04-13 to 2026-04-20), representing a change of -0.23 stars.
assumptions: Both periods have comparable review volume and source distribution
Rating scale is consistent across both periods
No systematic bias in review collection between periods
